messages:
Maya: Quick flag 16px compact rows are causing lots of mistaken taps on the overflow kebab. On touch devices the icon hit target is literally the same size as the icon which is bad. Screenshot: https://figma.redwood/compact-row-issue.png
Julien: Yep saw this on the canary. The row padding was reduced but we left the icon button at 24px visual size, hit area got clipped by overflow.
Priya: For context, product asked for denser rows to fit more items. We shipped `spacing.tokens.rowY = 8` for compact, but the interactive controls didn't get the hitbox token.
Omar: Proposed quick fix: keep visual icon at 16/16 but enforce a 40x40 touch target via invisible padding: `padding: 12px; margin: -12px;` on the icon button. Works but tricky for layout constraints in tables.
Maya: I worry about negative margin hacks in table cells; they make clipping and overflow unpredictable, especially with sticky columns.
Julien: Another approach: make the kebab a separate cell (right-aligned) with fixed width so hit area isn't impacted by text truncation. Might require table column adjustments but cleaner.
Priya: ProductOps: we'd prefer not to increase row height. Increasing column width for the action column is acceptable if it doesn't push critical columns off-screen.
A11yBot: Reminder: WCAG recommends 44x44px minimum target for touch. If we can't meet that visually, provide alternative keyboard/assistive affordances and announce via aria-describedby.
Omar: For toast behavior: when a user taps kebab -> Retry, we show a spinner inside the row then a toast anchored to top-right. In some modal states the toast sits behind the modal because we render toasts in the app root z-index lower than modals. Users miss the confirmation.
Maya: Ugh. That's a regression. Toasts should be able to float above modals for global notifications. We should assess z-index scale: currently modal: z-900, toast: z-800.
Julien: I think toasts that are related to row actions can be anchored to the row (inline transient message) instead of global toast. That avoids z-index fights with modals.
Priya: Inline message would be great for action feedback on dense tables 1 less visual clutter. But for long async ops across routes, still want global toast.
Omar: Implementation note: create two flavors: `Toast.global` (current) and `Toast.inline(targetEl)` that positions absolutely within the table cell and doesn't rely on global stacking.
Maya: Also add a rule: inline toasts must not overlap the row height; they can expand above the row with `transform: translateY(-8px)` if needed. Keep animations small.
A11yBot: Inline toasts must be reachable by screen readers. Use `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"` and ensure focus is not stolen.
Priya: From tokens side, we have `spacing.xs`, `spacing.sm` but no token for action-cell width or min-hit-target. Maybe: `layout.actionHit = 40px` and `layout.actionColumnGap = 8px`. Is adding these tokens justified?
Maya: I prefer not to proliferate tokens unless we standardize them. For now, let's document recommended action hit (40px) in the component docs and use CSS variable `--action-hit` that maps to tokens later.
Julien: I'll spin a small PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/2399 that changes kebab to a standalone cell, enforces `--action-hit: 40px`, and adds `Toast.inline`. Demo page included.
Omar: QA checklist: 1) touch target >= 40px on mobile, 2) inline toast appears above the row and is visible when modals open, 3) keyboard focus order unchanged, 4) no layout shift on toast show.
Priya: I'll update product spec and confirm A/B won't be needed if it's just hit targets + inline toast. If column width change is noticeable, we can rollout via feature flag.
Maya: Thanks folks. Let's ship the fix behind a flag and run on canary for a week. I'll add the change to the design kit and note the `--action-hit` variable. :tada:
